Yes, HCA Healthcare, Inc. announced changes to its dividend policy in the annual report. The Board of Directors initiated a cash dividend program in 2018 with regular quarterly dividends. In 2022, the Board declared four quarterly dividends of $0.56 per share, totaling $2.24 per share for the year. On January 26, 2023, the Board declared a quarterly dividend of $0.60 per share payable on March 31, 2023. The declaration, amount, and timing of dividends are subject to capital availability and Board determinations that dividends are in the best interest of stockholders and comply with laws and agreements. Future dividends depend on factors such as cash flows, capital requirements, and financial condition [S8, S9, S10, S13].

Yes, Brave Bison Group plc mentioned mergers and acquisitions in the annual report. They acquired Best Response Media Limited on 28 April 2022, a specialist ecommerce and mobile development company focused on the Adobe Commerce Platform. The acquisition was financed by existing cash balances, and the report details the fair value of assets acquired, liabilities assumed, and the consideration paid including initial cash, completion accounts adjustment, and deferred cash consideration. The goodwill recognized represents the acquired workforce and expected synergies from integration. The Group also carried out a full fair value adjustment exercise related to the acquisition of Greenlight Digital and Greenlight Commerce on 1 September 2021. Furthermore, the Group announced the purchase of 100% of the issued share capital of Social Chain Limited on 3 February 2023, a leading social media and influencer marketing agency, with an initial consideration of £7.7 million. These acquisitions are part of the Group's acquisition and integration strategy [S13, S14, S15, S18, S20, S17].

Yes, Seiko Epson Corporation announced its dividend policy in the annual report. The company aims to sustain business growth and generate stable cash flow while actively returning profits to shareholders. It has set a consolidated dividend payout ratio target of around 40% based on profit after tax from business profit. The company pays cash dividends twice a year, with the year-end dividend determined by the general shareholders' meeting and the interim dividend by the board of directors. The company also intends to be more active in purchasing treasury shares as warranted by share price and capital situation. The annual dividend paid was ¥62 per share, and the Articles of Incorporation allow for an interim dividend with a record date of September 30 each year by resolution of the board of directors. There is no mention of a change to this policy in the report [S1].
